scientific_integrity: Explicit deterministic exhaustive acyclic discrete-Morse matchings on complete nonempty face posets, independent defining face check, reduced mod-2 Betti checks. The Morse theorem, not mod-2 homology, proves the integral wedges.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification for ordinary 5-cut complexes of M_{2n} with n=4,5,6,7,8; no all-n theorem, equivariant module, or independent audit. Unindexed priority sources remain possible.
title: Five integral homotopy types at the five-cut boundary of Möbius ladders
